experiences.position: Founder & Product Engineer | AI Audio Analysis (Xora)
experiences.description:
Built Xora from scratch: an AI-powered audio analysis platform that gives producers and mixing engineers structured feedback on mix and master readiness, combining signal processing metrics with a hybrid scoring engine.
· Designed the full evaluation pipeline covering spectral balance, dynamics, and loudness analysis, with driver-based issue detection to surface and prioritize the most impactful mix problems
· Built an end-to-end asynchronous processing architecture (upload → worker → analysis → report) using Node.js, Supabase, and Python workers
· Developed a report engine that translates raw audio metrics into structured, actionable feedback, the kind typically reserved for professional mixing sessions
· Integrated Stripe billing, usage quotas, and subscription state management with webhook-driven synchronization
